translationRepairs: My mother's body has not yet been buried, and my father's life hangs by a thread; I and my five brothers are all still young.
My mother's body has not yet been buried, and my father's life hangs by a thread; we five brothers are all still young.
慮兄弟五人 is a group of five brothers including Lü; 慮身居長 in the next sentence confirms he is the eldest of that five, not a sixth sibling.
Emperor Xiaowen of Wei issued an edict specially pardoning his father's capital crime and commuting him to exile to a distant region.
Emperor Xiaowen issued an edict specially pardoning his father's capital crime and commuting him to exile to a distant region.
孝文帝 does not include 魏, so 'of Wei' should be dropped from the literal line; the proposed compression of 從遠流 to 'distant exile' is only stylistic.

When the three-year mourning was complete, grieving that he had never known his father, he put on the hemmed sackcloth of the most severe mourning, ate only gruel, wore only coarse garments, and vowed it for the rest of his life.

When the three-year mourning was complete, grieving that he had never known his father, he put on the unhemmed sackcloth of the most severe mourning, ate only gruel, wore only coarse garments, and vowed it for the rest of his life.
追服斬衰 names the unhemmed sackcloth of deepest mourning; 'hemmed' would be 齊衰 and reverses the grade.
An edict ordered the Imperial Secretariat to proclaim Yin's exemplary conduct, and granted him an honorary supernumerary title as well.
An edict specially ordered the office of collected writings to proclaim Yin's exemplary conduct, and granted him an honorary supernumerary title as well.
別敕集書 names the collected-writings office, not the Imperial Secretariat (尚書).
The inspector, because the Xida brothers' conduct was renowned in their village, posthumously enfeoffed Xida's father as Administrator of Bohai.
The inspector, because the Xida brothers' conduct was renowned in their village, posthumously appointed Xida's father as Administrator of Bohai.
板贈 is a posthumous board appointment to 勃海太守, not an enfeoffment.
The responsible officials reported to the throne, marked his lane, and restored him from corvée labor, in order to proclaim filial righteousness.
The responsible officials reported to the throne, marked his lane, and exempted him from corvée labor, in order to proclaim filial righteousness.
標閭復役 uses 復 as exemption from corvée, not restoration to labor duty.
Yellow Gate Attendant Sun Huiwei heard of it and said, "In this man I see the devotion of Lian and Fan."
Yellow Gate Attendant Sun Huiwei heard of it and said, "In this man I see the devotion of Lian Fan."
廉範 is one personal name; splitting it into 'Lian and Fan' invents a second person.

Hu was also supremely filial. His mother, Lady Yan, had died in enemy territory, and no one knew whether she was alive or dead.
Hu was also supremely filial. His mother, Lady Yan, had been lost in enemy territory, and no one knew whether she was alive or dead.
沒於敵境，不測存亡 states that her survival was unknown; s0159 久乖膝下 confirms long separation, not a recorded death.
His father Yanjun served in provincial and commandery offices, repeatedly as master of records clerk.
His father Yanjun served in provincial and commandery offices, repeatedly as merit officer (gongcao) and principal clerk.
累為功曹主簿 names two offices, 功曹 and 主簿; the original fused them and dropped 功曹 as a separate post.
Leading several hundred soldiers, he followed General Han Qinhu's vanguard in a night crossing, fought fiercely, and was wounded.
Leading several hundred soldiers, he followed Han Qinhu's vanguard in a night crossing, fought fiercely, and was wounded.
從韓擒虎先鋒夜濟 names Han Qinhu without the title General.
The thirty juan of his Five Classics with Commentary and the twenty juan of his collected writings were all lost in the turmoil of war and no longer survive.
The thirty juan of his Great Meaning of the Five Classics and the twenty juan of his collected writings were all lost in the turmoil of war and no longer survive.
《五經大義》 is the titled work Great Meaning of the Five Classics, not a commentary edition of the Five Classics.
The thirty juan of his Five Classics with Commentary that he composed, and the twenty juan of his collected writings, were all lost in the turmoil of war and no longer survive.
The thirty juan of the Great Meaning of the Five Classics that he composed, and the twenty juan of his collected writings, were all lost in the turmoil of war and no longer survive.
《五經大義》 is Great Meaning of the Five Classics; 大義 is not 'with Commentary'.

When his mother grew old and ill, Xiaosu tended her day and night, changing her bedding whenever it grew damp or dry. For years he wasted away with worry, and all who saw him were moved to grief.
When his mother grew old and ill, Xiaosu watched and changed her bedding whenever it grew damp or dry. For years he wasted away with worry, and all who saw him were moved to grief.
視易燥濕 refers to watching and changing bedding for damp or dry; the Chinese does not say he tended her day and night.
At the graves of his grandparents and parents, he all carried earth to form the mounds.
At the graves of his grandparents and parents, he carried earth to form the mounds.
皆 belongs with 祖父母、父母墓; 'he all carried' is ungrammatical and misplaces the adverb.
Zhangsun Lü and the others were perhaps of ministerial and noble lineage, drawing on ritual and instruction;
Some of Zhangsun Lü and the others came from ministerial and noble lineage, drawing on ritual and instruction;
Correlative 或出…或出 in this sentence and the next marks 'some… others…', not epistemic 'perhaps'; the proposal correctly drops 'perhaps' but omits that distributive 或.
